usageNote: 描述身体上或情感上'喘不过气'的感觉，既能说真实憋气，也能形容压力超大！

examples.en: At high altitude, it wasn't easy to breathe, so we had to stop and rest.
examples.zh: 在高海拔地区呼吸很困难，所以我们不得不停下来休息。

examples.en: With all the stress at work, it wasn't easy to breathe without feeling anxious.
examples.zh: 工作压力这么大，很难不焦虑地正常呼吸。
